\section*{Problem: Combinatorial optimization problems involve the integration of location selection issues and vehicle routing problems. The paper refers to these problems as “Location-or-Routing Problems” (LoRP), and argues that they represent a generalization of Location-Routing Problems (LRP) and Set Covering Problems. This creates a family of problems with various variants, such as HMLoRP and pMLoRP. The core mathematical model involves a set covering model based on paths, and it constitutes a Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) problem. Due to the exponential growth of path variables, the paper employs the Branch-and-Price algorithm for accurate solution calculations.}
